product_name.rule: The product is written `bhasa`, lowercase Latin, in every language. The Devanagari common noun भाषा (language) is never used as the product name.

numerals.rule: UI chrome digits follow the interface language: Devanagari digits (०-९) when the interface is नेपाली, Latin digits when it is English. Quoted evidence always keeps the digits of its source, untouched.

time.rule: Message lists show relative time in the interface language (e.g. २ मिनेट अघि / 2 min ago). Absolute times are 24-hour, locale-formatted, never 12-hour AM/PM in a Nepali interface.

calendar.rule: UI chrome timestamps are Gregorian and are labelled as such whenever an absolute date is shown (ई.सं. / AD). No Bikram Sambat conversion is performed by the UI. Document effective dates are stored and shown exactly as published, in both systems, labelled.

refusal_strings.rule: The two byte-frozen refusal strings are fetched from the deployed proof document and compared after NFC normalisation. They are never typed into source.
